description.zh: 数据集ID（支持输入多个数据集ID，用","分隔）
description.en: Dataset IDs. You can specify multiple dataset IDs separated by commas (,).

description.zh: 指定要查询的页码，默认是1，起始是1
description.en: The page number to query. Default is 1. Page numbering starts from 1.

description.zh: 分页参数，每页显示条数，默认值10
description.en: Number of entries per page. Default is 10.

description.zh: 指定规则所适用的对象标签，可设置多个
description.en: Object tags that the rule applies to. You can specify multiple tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-dataset-list --dataset-ids 4add6a61804e47858266883e00000000 --dataset-name IPwhitelist --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tag Value=value Key=env --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DescribeDatasetList --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key env --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --DatasetName IPwhitelist --DatasetIds 4add6a61804e47858266883e00000000 --Tag.1.Value value
